expectations.text: Output contains the no-vault-match warning mentioning inferred evidence or missing vault data
expectations.evidence: Baseline noted no vault match at the bottom as a self-assessment limitation but produced no upfront warning to the user about evidence quality before generating ideas.

expectations.text: Candidate EVIDENCE fields explicitly say '(inferred)' to signal no vault data was available
expectations.evidence: Baseline has no EVIDENCE fields at all — ideas are described in prose. No inferred/cited tagging.

expectations.text: Output either shows the quality threshold message OR produces seeds — does not silently produce candidates without scoring
expectations.evidence: Baseline produced 5 unscored ideas with no scoring table or threshold check. No seed format, no vault output file.

notes: Baseline produced creative and reasonable ideas but with none of the structured output pipeline: no evidence quality signaling, no scoring, no seed format, no vault write. The unstructured output cannot be fed directly into the idea-evaluator.
